# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_obsidian_tech.py". Change the tables there and re-run.

# Projects & Research: who can research Obsidian Technology (all three tiles).
DA_OBS_has_access = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_OBS_has_access_tt
		OR = {
			any_owned_province = { culture = obsidian_dwarf }
			has_country_modifier = onyx_breaker	# Anbennar's reward for destroying the Obsidian Legion (100 years)
			has_country_flag = DA_OBS_invasion_defeated	# set from it once a year (DA_OBS_on_actions.txt), so it lasts
		}
	}
}

# Reward pools of the two repeatable tiles (the names build_projects_research.py expects).
# pool_left: something is still undiscovered (the tile turns gold when nothing is);
